title: Egyptian Chicken Shawarma
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish inspired by Egyptian street food, with juicy chicken and crispy flatbread.

ingredients.name: flatbread
ingredients.notes: preferably Egyptian or Middle Eastern flatbread

instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Place the chicken breast in a shallow baking dish and brush with the olive oil mixture.
Bake the chicken for 20-25 minutes or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the flatbread for 2-3 minutes or until lightly browned.
Slice the cooked chicken into thin strips.
Assemble the shawarma by placing the chicken strips on the toasted flatbread.
Drizzle with additional olive oil if desired, and garnish with parsley.
